rules.title: Berkeley 2026 Annual General Adjustment (AGA) of 1.0%
rules.requirement: For 2026, eligible Berkeley landlords may raise a covered unit's rent ceiling by no more than 1.0%, and not before January 1, 2026. The landlord must meet the qualifying conditions in Regulation 1148 and give the required notice. Tenants can contact the Rent Board at 510-981-7368 with questions.

coverage.summary: Units under Berkeley's rent stabilization program with permanent rent ceilings. This notice does not state which buildings are covered or exempt. The 2026 AGA does not apply to tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 with rents set under Costa-Hawkins.

rules.exemptions: The 2026 AGA may not adjust rents for tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 whose rents were set under the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act. Landlords must meet the eligibility conditions in Regulation 1148.
rules.quoted_span: At its regular meeting on October 16, 2025, the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026.
rules.interaction: The AGA does not apply to tenancies whose rents were set under the state Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act, if the tenancy began on or after January 1, 2025.

notes: This public notice announces the 2026 AGA only. It does not state Berkeley's coverage rules (building age, unit counts, exemptions), so the structured coverage fields are left null. The quoted span normalizes the line breaks in the source PDF to single spaces.
